chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah Most High support him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan and others, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Ibn Ribāṭ, from Yūnus ibn ʿAmmār, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the wudu (ablution) for salat (prayer), and he said: “Once, once.”

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abā ʿAbdillāh, the Imam addressed in the narration
key_terms.الْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification performed before salat (prayer)
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him, honorific for the Imam
key_terms.لِلصَّلَاةِ: for salat (prayer), indicating the purpose of the wudu (ablution)

ai.seo_question: How many times should each part be washed in wudu (ablution) for salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the washing in wudu (ablution) for salat (prayer) is to be done once for each part. It is a concise legal narration concerning the prescribed manner of ritual purification before prayer.
